items.title: Planned Technical Works on 29.09.2026
items.summary: Hey everyone, on September 29th from 07:00 GMT, the War Thunder game servers may be unavailable due to the short planned maintenance. Thank you for your understanding.

items.title: The Pro League Major III has Concluded, the Grand Finals Are Coming!
items.summary: Last weekend marked the conclusion of the WTCS Pro League Major III, the third and last pro major event of the War Thunder Championship Series regular season.
